initialReview.summary: For sessions marked wristband required, free limited wristbands are distributed each event morning from 8:30 AM in the Concourse C Lobby, first come, first served. Each attendee needs their own wristband and a valid Atlanta badge for that day. Arrive at the session at least 30 minutes before it ends; there are no standby or overflow queues.

initialReview.title: The Council's Call: Atlanta immersive dinner announced
initialReview.summary: Friday, November 13 at the Wimbish House: choose 5:30–7:30 PM or 8:30–10:30 PM ET for an interactive Magic dinner, open bar and $15 Uber voucher. Tickets are $299 including taxes and fees, on sale October 8 at 10 AM PT. Ages 21+; an Atlanta badge is required. Tickets are nonrefundable and nontransferable; dietary requests are due November 1.
